+## Summary
+
+Increases the pricing cache time-to-live (TTL) from 15 minutes to 1 hour to reduce unnecessary cache invalidations and improve performance.
+
+## Changes
+
+- **Cache TTL**: Increased `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` from 900 to 3600 seconds
+  - Previous: 15-minute cache duration
+  - New: 1-hour cache duration
+- **Code cleanup**: Removed unused `lookup()` function that was no longer being called
+
+## Motivation
+
+Extending the cache TTL from 15 minutes to 1 hour reduces the frequency of cache refreshes, decreasing load on the pricing feed and improving response times for pricing lookups. This is appropriate when pricing data changes infrequently and staleness within a 1-hour window is acceptable.
+
+## Testing
+
+- Verify that pricing data is still correctly served from cache
+- Monitor pricing feed load and hit rates after deployment
+- Confirm no regressions in price accuracy or cache behavior
